data.title: GET Query Builder
data.statement:
You must output the complete URL for an HTTP GET request using a given base URL and a list of parameters.

Rules:

• If there are parameters, the first one must be separated from the base URL by a {{?}}.
• Following parameters must be separated by an {{&}}.
• Each parameter is formatted as [[key]]{{=}}[[value]].
• The parameters must be added to the URL in the order they are given in the input.
• If there are no parameters, output [[baseUrl]] as is.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You must output the complete URL for an HTTP GET request using a given base URL and a list of parameters.

Rules:

• If there are parameters, the first one must be separated from the base URL by a ?.
• Following parameters must be separated by an &.
• Each parameter is formatted as key=value.
• The parameters must be added to the URL in the order they are given in the input.
• If there are no parameters, output baseUrl as is.
Input
Line 1: A string baseUrl.
Line 2: An integer N representing the number of parameters.
Next N lines: Two space-separated strings key and value representing a parameter.
Output
Line 1: A single string representing the correctly formatted URL.
Constraints
0 ≤ N ≤ 10
1 ≤ length of baseUrl, value ≤ 50
1 ≤ length of key ≤ 20
baseUrl contains alphanumeric characters, dots, and /.
key and value contain only alphanumeric characters and dots.
Example
Input
api.mysite.com/data
0
Output
api.mysite.com/data
